;; The interior mode is background; side midpoint colors define directions.
;; Preserve the border and clear the interior before moving original cells.
;; Matching side colors step once inward; blocked or unmatched cells stay put.
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (let ((bg (first (sort-by (unique (reduce append (list)
                (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (at g r c)) (range 1 (- w 1)))) (range 1 (- h 1)))))
              (lambda (v) (- 0 (for/sum ((r (range 1 (- h 1))))
                                  (for/sum ((c (range 1 (- w 1))))
                                    (if (= (at g r c) v) 1 0)))))))))
      (let ((top-c (at g 0 (/ w 2)))
            (bot-c (at g (- h 1) (/ w 2)))
            (left-c (at g (/ h 2) 0))
            (right-c (at g (/ h 2) (- w 1))))
        (let ((base (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
                (if (or (zero? r) (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c) (= c (- w 1)))
                  (at g r c) bg)))))
          (reduce (lambda (acc r)
            (reduce (lambda (acc2 c)
              (let ((v (at g r c)))
                (if (= v bg) acc2
                  (let ((dr (if (= v top-c) -1 (if (= v bot-c) 1 (if (= v left-c) 0 (if (= v right-c) 0 0)))))
                        (dc (if (= v left-c) -1 (if (= v right-c) 1 (if (= v top-c) 0 (if (= v bot-c) 0 0))))))
                    (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc)))
                      (if (and (>= nr 1) (<= nr (- h 2)) (>= nc 1) (<= nc (- w 2)))
                        (set-cell acc2 nr nc v)
                        (if (or (not (zero? dr)) (not (zero? dc)))
                          (set-cell acc2 r c v)
                          (set-cell acc2 r c v))))))))
              acc (range 1 (- w 1))))
            base (range 1 (- h 1)))))))))
